row.title: Today's failures shared seven root-cause classes; each now has a check
row.body: DRIFT-GUARD-1 (foundation/driftguard.py, doctrine/driftguard.json): declared-vs-live drift (repo visibility reset hourly by the tick, seed/worker/src/declared.js; stale visual baselines roll forward), single-route schedules (tick pulses every tenant /pulse/watch hourly; crons counted against the plan limit), missed push triggers (dispatched by dg-triggers), empty-commit loops, account drift (retired account by sha256 only), built-without-evidence (graph rows read live; checks refuse a deploy verified only by the tick /health), and hand-kept repo lists (selftest reads org/repos.json and tenant-repos.json).
